incident.what: a teardown script meant for a staging project deletes the production memory project

A.title: A  values backup
A.backup: `fact list` export: id + text of every live fact
A.how: `fact add` every text into a new project

B.title: B  values + version chain
B.backup: the export + each fact's version texts from `fact trace`
B.how: replay each fact: `fact add` its first version, then `fact update` through the rest, in order

C.title: C  versions + original times
C.backup: the export + full `fact trace`: texts, times, original id
C.how: replay like B; the last write also stores the original id and every version's original timestamp in metadata
